key_insight: Bellman Policy Optimization (BPO) reformulates Policy Mirror Descent for terminal-reward autoregressive generation into a trajectory-level objective that avoids intermediate value estimation while preserving the same unique optimum.
engineering_relevance: BPO offers a practical critic-free reinforcement learning recipe for improving LLM reasoning, reducing implementation complexity and potential instability from state-value critics.
method: Use Bellman equations to convert PMD into a trajectory-level objective for terminal rewards.
Derive a practical BPO loss by approximating the reformulated objective.
Apply a smoothed complementary-token-probability ratio as a mismatch-correction weight.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks showing that BPO is effective for improving reasoning performance.
watch_item: The practical loss relies on approximations and a carefully designed correction weight, so training stability and sensitivity to implementation details may matter.
